applications.name: Skope
applications.repo_description_en: Offline-first Wikidata scope explorer for Kristal. Search any QID, choose per-branch depth and relation filters, detect external convergence candidates, and export reproducible working graph snapshots. Generic Python/SQLite tool with external project recipes; no domain data or canonical promotion.
applications.scope_authority: application-owned local working recipe; no canon

applications.name: Kristal Iroquoiens Working
applications.repo_description_en: Working model for an Iroquoian-peoples Kristal anchored to Wikidata Q110654499. Owns scope recipes, editorial seeds, source archives, candidate axes, provenance and review workflows. Uses Skope as a separate generic tool to build an offline-capable non-canonical skeleton.
applications.scope_authority: editorial subject scope; working only, no canonical validation
applications.depends_on_tool: Skope via --recipe and --db; no copy of skope code

applications.name: Ekole
applications.repo_description_en: Québec primary-school learning environment built around 202 Kristal authoring workspaces. Includes learner and teacher portals, a local operations console, derived catalogue and an offline-first Moodle projection planner. Editorial and v9/v10 qualification remain pending.
applications.scope_authority: editorial state and derived learning surfaces; no qualified Kristal canon

applications.name: kOA Digital Ecosystem
applications.repo_description_en: Cross-system architecture and integration map for kOA: ownership, versioned contracts, trust boundaries, maturity and release coordination across Kristal, EncyKlopedia, Da’at, UCKK, Koali and related applications including Skope and Ékole.
